modules.title: Planning, records and safe handover
modules.purpose: Document purpose, resources, checks, findings, unresolved issues and handover without creating a live-work procedure.
modules.writtenResponsePrompt: Complete a fictional electric-fence planning and handover brief. Identify purpose, current sources, resource status, hold points, open findings, next owner and evidence still required.
modules.relationship: Existing formative module response. The learning record indexes whether it is saved locally; it does not duplicate, submit, score or assess the response.
